articles.title: Google Warns AI Consciousness Debate Could Become a Political Battleground
articles.snippet: A new paper from Google DeepMind argues that disagreements over whether AI is conscious could spill into politics, law, and public institutions.

articles.title: $1.9M in Fake Bets Drove Polymarket Hype: WSJ
articles.snippet: A Wall Street Journal probe found none of the roughly $1.9 million in bets shown across 1,100-plus creator videos were real.

articles.title: House Republican Introduces Insider Trading Bill to Ban Lawmaker Prediction Market Bets
articles.snippet: The bill is meant to curb potential insider trading, blocking lawmakers and family members from policy-related prediction market bets.
